# Nebius Token Factory live probe — Nemotron-3 + Qwen3-Embedding

**Date:** 2026-09-19
**Account endpoint:** `https://api.tokenfactory.nebius.com/v1`
**Script:** `tests/scripts/probe_token_factory.py`
**Raw results:** `/tmp/tf-sweep-final.json` (regenerated by the command below)

This is the probe-first gate for the Nemotron-on-Token-Factory workstream
(see `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-19-nemotron-token-factory.md` in the
parent repo). Every registered Token Factory model is exercised against its
**real** provider before any role mapping is locked in.

## How to reproduce

```bash
cd draftly-agent-backend
# .env needs NEBIUS_TOKEN_FACTORY_API_KEY (and optional _BASE_URL)
uv run python tests/scripts/probe_token_factory.py --embeddings \
  --out /tmp/tf-sweep-final.json
# faster, skips the ~260K/~1M-token context smoke probes:
uv run python tests/scripts/probe_token_factory.py --quick --embeddings
```

Each run makes live, billable calls. The full run (context windows) costs
roughly **$0.002** in total on Nemotron-3 pricing (see the cost column).

| `nemotron-nano-fast` | `nebius_token_factory` | 10 | **4/4** | 11.8 s | 1.22 s | $0.000014 |

**Verdict: all four registered endpoints pass every capability-matched probe.**

### Per-probe detail

| model | basic | tool_call | structured | ttft_cost | context_window |
|---|:--:|:--:|:--:|:--:|:--:|
| `nemotron-nano-fast` | ok | ok | n/a | ok (in=22 out=54) | ok @ 262,000 |
| `nemotron-super-research` | ok | ok | n/a | ok (in=22 out=27) | ok @ 256,000 |
| `nemotron-ultra-doc` | ok | ok | ok | ok (in=22 out=29) | ok @ 1,024,000 |
| `embedding-nebius-token-factory` | — | — | — | — | `embed_1536` → `dims=1536` |

- **basic** — `Reply with exactly: pong` returns `pong`.
- **tool_call** — real tool invocation asserted via `toolUse` blocks in
  `agent.messages` (not just prose claiming a call).
- **structured** — `structured_output_model=ProbeAnswer` returns a valid
  `{"city": "New York City", "population_millions": 8.5}`.
- **ttft_cost** — a fresh, **tool-less** streaming agent; first `data` event
  gives TTFT, `metrics.accumulated_usage` gives tokens, and cost is computed
  from the registered `input_cost_per_1m_tokens` / `output_cost_per_1m_tokens`.
- **context_window** — a filler document sized to ~90% of the advertised
  window (tokenizer-variance margin) must still answer `ok`. Sizes touched:
  262K (nano), 256K (super), 1,024K (ultra). Slight overshoot is expected and
  is why the probe targets 90% rather than 100%.

## Findings that changed the implementation

1. **Ultra model id was wrong.** `nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Ultra-550b-a55b`
   returns HTTP 404 ("model does not exist"). The live `/v1/models` listing
   exposes `nvidia/Nemotron-3-Ultra-550b-a55b` (no `NVIDIA-` prefix). The
   registered default was corrected in `factory.py`.
2. **Token Factory rejects `tools: []`.** Strands' `OpenAIModel.format_request`
   always emits the `tools` key, even when empty. vLLM on Token Factory
   returns HTTP 400 ("`tools` must not be an empty array") — which broke every
   **tool-less** chat call and all `structured_output` calls. Fixed with
   `NebiusTokenFactoryModel.format_request`, which drops an empty `tools`
   (and `tool_choice`) before the request is sent. Covered by
   `tests/unit/models/test_nebius_token_factory.py::TestNebiusTokenFactoryModelFormatRequest`.
3. **`reasoningContent is not supported in multi-turn`** is logged by the
   endpoint on follow-up turns; it is advisory and did not fail any probe.
4. **Embedding dims confirmed.** `Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-8B` returns exactly
   1536 dims, matching the `VECTOR(1536)` schema.

| `nemotron-super-research` | `NEMOTRON_SUPER_MODEL_ID` | `nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b` |
| `nemotron-ultra-doc` | `NEMOTRON_ULTRA_MODEL_ID` | `nvidia/Nemotron-3-Ultra-550b-a55b` |
| `embedding-nebius-token-factory` | `EMBEDDING_MODEL_ID` | `Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-8B` |

## Cost model

Input/output prices are the registered Token Factory rates per 1M tokens:

| model | context | input $/1M | output $/1M |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| `nemotron-nano-fast` | 262,000 | 0.06 | 0.24 |
| `nemotron-super-research` | 256,000 | 0.30 | 0.90 |
| `nemotron-ultra-doc` | 1,024,000 | 1.00 | 3.00 |

A typical probe turn (22 in / ~30 out) costs a fraction of a cent, so a full
sweep is cheap; the context-window probe dominates wall-clock (≈92 s for the
1M-token ultra call) but not cost (~$0.001).

- If Token Factory changes model ids again, re-run the `--quick --embeddings`
